# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# Shared vectors for the clock segment's strftime(3) spec, built from the
# theme's clock settings. The agent's `ClockResolver::time_spec` is the
# authority whenever the agent renders; the shells' local copies MUST produce
# the same spec, character for character. Read by:
#   - Bash:  __gpy_clock_time_spec    (tests/bash/clock_time_spec_vectors.test.bash)
#   - Zsh:   __gpy_clock_time_spec    (tests/zsh/clock_time_spec_vectors.test.zsh)
#   - Fish:  __gpy_clock_date_format  (tests/fish/clock_time_spec_vectors.test.fish)
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated:
#   __time_format<TAB>__clock_show_leading_zero<TAB>__clock_show_seconds<TAB>expected
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The whole-column token \e
# means the variable is EMPTY (empty and unset are treated alike); `expected`
# is literal. Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields no
# vectors.
# Contract: only `24` selects the 24-hour clock and only `1` enables an
# option; anything else is the default (12-hour, no leading zero, no seconds).
\e
